title: Deploying the app
description: Use when deploying the app: build the image, push it to the registry, roll the deployment.
overview: A slide deck with one slide per deployment step and no live demo.

steps.actions: Run `docker build` and tag the image 1.2.

evidence.quote: build the image with docker build

steps.actions: Run `docker push` after logging in to the registry.

evidence.quote: docker push uploads it to the registry

steps.actions: Run `kubectl rollout restart` and watch the pods come up.

evidence.quote: kubectl rollout restart deploys the new image
